messages:
Maya L: Quick sync — AcmeAI asked for a short-term 'embedded high-throughput' add-on for their pilot. They want ~1M embeddings/mo, P95 <=100–120ms, monthly billing with a soft cap and overage. Can we scope this as a microtier or map to Dedicated? Need launch criteria and handoff.
Sam T: FYI this is the pilot we discussed. They'd pay a premium for guaranteed throughput and latency. Prefer monthly commit but ok with short trial credits. Can we promise consistent latency on Hosted?
Jon P: We should avoid a new permanent SKU unless justified. Proposal: MVP as a hosted add-on 'embeddings-priority' (delta price) + reserved capacity option. Need SLOs, telemetry, and legal on SLA. Pilot gating: perf + cost check.
Keegan M: From infra POV: hosted priority requires queue isolation + tenant-level cache. Work estimate: 4–6 dev days + perf runs. We'll also need a routable priority lane and billing tag.
Priya R: Pricing options: 1) Microtier: $1k/mo base + $0.00015 per embedding over softcap. 2) Reserved: commit discount 20% with min 3mo. Define softcap (e.g., 1M/mo) and overage rounding. Trial credits: 100k embeddings.
Sam T: Customer prefers monthly commit with rollover for unused capacity. Legal flagged rollovers as revenue risk — need clear limits.
Maya L: Launch criteria (suggested): 1) Pilot with AcmeAI or similar for 2 weeks at 100k embeddings/day, 2) P95 <= 120ms on hosted, 3) Billing/metering validated end-to-end, 4) Sales acceptance of contract terms. Owner: Jon P (product) + Keegan M (eng).
Keegan M: Action items:
- instrument per-route latency and billing tag
- add route-level throttles and queueing
- perf test harness
Code snippet for route prototype:
```
route: /v1/embeddings/priority
capacity: reserved
qps: 200
```
LaunchBot: feature branch created: feature/embeds-priority. Staging deploy succeeded, CI tests 3/4 passing.
Sam T: I'll push on commit terms but can't promise rollovers. Will try for 1-month rollover cap or higher overage price if no rollover.
Priya R: Also recommend automated fallback: when capacity constrained, route falls back to standard embeddings + auto-credit for impacted tokens. That should be in the contract as a mitigation.
Maya L: Decision for MVP: implement as Hosted add-on (no rollovers), offer microtier + reserved commit option, pilot required, SLA written as SLO + credit policy. Owners: Jon P, Keegan M. Next check-in Friday 11am PT.
Jon P: I'll draft the spec and SLO doc today and post link in #product.
Keegan M: I'll spin up infra tickets and estimate precise dev days.
Priya R: I'll draft pricing table and sample contract language; will sync with legal.
Sam T: Looping in @legal to review SLA/rollover language — tagging to get quicker turnaround.
Maya L: Thanks all — please keep updates in this thread so we have a single source. :thumbsup:
